    How long do the Oscars last?
    How long do the Oscars last? The usual duration of the ceremony is approximately three and a half hours, from the moment the host, in this case, Conan O'Brien, kicks off the night with his opening jokes, to the presentation of the Oscar for Best Picture, which is typically the last award announced.12 hours ago

    How long are Oscars supposed to last?
    In terms of broadcast length, the ceremony generally averages three and a half hours. The first Oscars, in 1929, lasted 15 minutes. At the other end of the spectrum, the 2002 ceremony lasted four hours and twenty-three minutes.
